name: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.4
changelog: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.4! Introduces the Secret Final Level: Stage 11 - Rainbow Skyway! Complete Stages 1 through 10 with zero damage (no collisions with mismatched traffic) to unlock the ultimate mastery gauntlet featuring all 46 core Hiragana characters. Features cosmic aurora skies, pulsing RGB neon curbs, floating cyber-torii arches, starfields, and permanent title screen replay once unlocked!
